remarks: Beautifully renovated two-bedroom condo in one of Darien's most convenient locations, just steps from Goodwives Shopping Center, the Metro-North train station, and downtown shops and restaurants.  Completely gutted and thoughtfully redesigned, the home features a stunning new kitchen, beautifully renovated baths, and stylish finishes throughout. The bright, open-concept main level flows from the kitchen into the dining and living areas, where a fireplace creates a warm, inviting focal point. A private gated courtyard and garden offer a peaceful outdoor retreat with direct access from the living area.  Upstairs, the primary suite features vaulted ceilings and a beautifully appointed en-suite bath with soaking tub and separate shower. A second en-suite bedroom and laundry complete the upper level.  Turnkey, sophisticated, and move-in ready, this is an exceptional rental offering with easy access to everything Darien has to offer.
